analysis.summary: Users must be able to log in to SauceDemo with valid credentials (standard_user/secret_sauce) to reach the inventory page; invalid credentials or empty username/password must be rejected with an error message and remain on the login page.

explicit_requirements.statement: Users must be able to log in to SauceDemo using valid credentials and reach the inventory page.
explicit_requirements.source_quote: Users must be able to log in to SauceDemo using valid credentials and reach the inventory page.

explicit_requirements.statement: Invalid credentials and empty submissions must be rejected.
explicit_requirements.source_quote: Invalid credentials and empty submissions must be rejected.

explicit_requirements.statement: Given standard_user / secret_sauce, the user is taken to the inventory page.
explicit_requirements.source_quote: Given standard_user / secret_sauce, the user is taken to the inventory page.

explicit_requirements.statement: Given invalid credentials, an error message is displayed and the user stays on the login page.
explicit_requirements.source_quote: Given invalid credentials, an error message is displayed and the user stays on the login page.

explicit_requirements.statement: Given empty username or password, an error message is displayed.
explicit_requirements.source_quote: Given empty username or password, an error message is displayed.

scenarios.title: Login with invalid credentials shows error and remains on login page
Login with empty username shows error
Login with empty password shows error
Login with both username and password empty shows error
scenarios.basis: Derived from FR-5 (empty username or password)

potentially_missed_scenarios.title: Login with valid credentials other than standard_user
potentially_missed_scenarios.rationale: Requirement only mentions standard_user/secret_sauce; other valid accounts may exist.

potentially_missed_scenarios.title: Case sensitivity of username and password
potentially_missed_scenarios.rationale: Not specified whether login is case‑sensitive.

potentially_missed_scenarios.title: Handling of leading/trailing whitespace in inputs
potentially_missed_scenarios.rationale: Unclear if whitespace is trimmed before validation.

potentially_missed_scenarios.title: Error message content verification
potentially_missed_scenarios.rationale: Exact wording of the error message is not defined.

potentially_missed_scenarios.title: Multiple consecutive failed login attempts
potentially_missed_scenarios.rationale: Potential lockout or throttling behavior not described.

missing_information: Exact text of the error messages displayed for invalid or empty credentials
Identifiers or selectors for username, password fields and login button
Definition of "invalid credentials" (e.g., wrong password, unknown username)
Whether the system is case‑sensitive for usernames/passwords
Behavior after multiple failed attempts (lockout, captcha, etc.)
ambiguities: Whether empty username and empty password are treated as separate scenarios or a combined one
Whether the same error message is shown for invalid credentials versus empty fields
Whether successful login is limited to the listed standard_user or any valid user
assumptions: Login validation is case‑sensitive unless otherwise specified
Error messages are displayed inline on the login page
The inventory page URL or identifier is known to the test team
analysis.validation_notes: All explicit statements from the user text are captured as requirements; derived scenarios follow logically; missing details are noted.
